# Vendor Material

`vendor/local/` contains manufacturer archives and programming utilities retained for local research. It is ignored by Git.

Do not execute bundled tools merely to inspect their contents. Prefer static inspection, manufacturer documentation, and open programming clients. If vendor source is imported into `firmware/`, copy only the required files and preserve their original license headers.

See [the external reference inventory](../docs/REFERENCE_INVENTORY.md) for package versions and SHA-256 hashes.
